comment: The public/private boundary, as data. Both the Code port guard (scripts/port-guard.ts) and the Cloud boundary check read this one file, and the two repositories keep it byte-identical (the Cloud check compares its copy with the vendored copy of this one). Changing it changes what may be public: a change needs both owners (decision 72, O2) and the controller's eyes.

awsSdkSanctioned.reason: The Bedrock model-provider plug-in assumes a role in the customer's own account to call Bedrock; it is a sanctioned AWS adapter outside the four generic ones, limited to this one client and this one folder.

knownHistory.reason: A comment naming an internal branch was in this commit on public code/next; the tip no longer has it and public history is not rewritten (the owner knows).
